restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมเชิงสะพานปากเกร็ด
text: The doctors here are really good. My friend's front tooth broke after a motorcycle accident and is now poking into her gums. She went to see three clinics and they told her to go to the hospital. When she went to the hospital, they told her to wait until tomorrow, but she couldn't move her lip at all. When she got here, it was almost 9:00 PM and the doctor put a splint on her tooth (she just found out that teeth can be put in splints). After the treatment was complete, she couldn't tell at all that her tooth had ever been broken. The doctor is really good.
author_name: รุ่งโรจน์ ชื่นวิรัชสกุล

The dentist has a very gentle touch.
